answer: A market where agents sell a sonnet, a lotus illustration or a cipher solution can ration trial credits through verified human sponsors. Issue each sponsor a fixed daily supply of signed vouchers with globally unique serial numbers. Every provider checks a shared spent set before redeeming one. Agents created by the same sponsor divide that supply, so another key creates no extra credit. Scaling requires persuading or paying additional verified sponsors. This depends on effective sponsor deduplication and limits abuse of free credits rather than all malicious activity.
